I am always glad to hear from researchers and students interested in epidemiologic methods, causal inference, and cancer/clinical/pharmacoepidemiology.

I am currently recruiting a postdoctoral fellow. If you would like to be considered, send a CV, a short note on your research interests and experience, and the names of two referees.
